changes: You can now choose how much damage each animal deals to players with the new optional playerDamageMultiplier setting in the animals section of config.lua, and existing configs keep working without changes.
Update lyre_bridge to 2.4.0 or newer so routine console logs are hidden by default and can be turned on per script in the lyre_bridge config.lua.
All languages are now fully translated, with corrected Finnish, Turkish and French texts.
!! IMPORTANT !! UPDATE lyre_bridge TO 2.3.0 OR NEWER BEFORE INSTALLING THIS VERSION.
The HUD show and hide hooks and the menu background blur are now set once in the lyre_bridge config.lua for every Lyre script.
Values you still set in this script's config.lua keep priority, so your current setup keeps working.
The menu background blur can be turned on or off again (off by default).

!! IMPORTANT !! ox_inventory and qs-inventory users: replace the hunting_bait, hunting_trap, portable_campfire, binoculars, hunting_encyclopedia and cooked meat item definitions with the ones in INVENTORY_ITEMS (on ox_inventory, remove the client export block and add consume = 0), otherwise these items will not work.
Make sure to update lyre_bridge alongside this resource (2.1.0 or newer is required).
Fixed hunting animals freezing or standing still for minutes, especially with several players around.
Shop, payments, missions, tournaments, traps and cooking are now fully validated by the server, and cooked meat can now be eaten.
Make sure to update lyre_bridge alongside this resource. The previous release was broken.
New Lyre Scripts structure: install and start lyre_bridge before this resource.
lyre_bridge is open source and is not included in Granted Assets ZIPs; download it here: https://github.com/lyrescripts/lyre_bridge
Inventory usable items and framework compatibility now go through lyre_bridge.
INVENTORY_ITEMS is no longer shipped as a separate folder; add the documented items to your inventory from the new release package/docs.
Release package cleaned and simplified; compare your old config with the new config before updating.
